The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
krb5utilClass = Class.forName("sun.security.jgss.krb5");
```
Reason:
The class reference "sun.security.jgss.krb5" was incorrect due to changes made in HADOOP-6941, which rendered this class name invalid. As a result, the method could not locate the correct class for Kerberos utilities, leading to failures in fetching service tickets.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
krb5utilClass = Class.forName("sun.security.jgss.krb5.Krb5Util");
```
Reason:
This line updates the class reference to the correct class name "sun.security.jgss.krb5.Krb5Util", allowing the method to successfully locate the necessary Kerberos utilities and thus properly fetch service tickets.
